prompt: Read nonnegative n; sum the cubes of odd i from 1 through n, then subtract 10.
target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total = 0.
LOOP (NUMBER i = 1 TILL i <= n, i++) { IF (i % 2 != 0) { total += i * i * i. } }
DISPLAYNL(total - 10).

prompt: Read nonnegative n and sum 3*i+2 for i=1..n.
target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total = 0.
LOOP (NUMBER i = 1 TILL i <= n, i++) { total += 3 * i + 2. }
DISPLAYNL(total).

prompt: Read nonnegative n. Multiply the values 2+i for i from 0 up to but not including n; print the product minus n.
target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER product=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<n, i++) { product*=i+2. }
DISPLAYNL(product-n).

prompt: Read nonnegative n; add evens and subtract odds from 1 through n, then add 11.

LOOP (NUMBER i = 1 TILL i <= n, i++) { IF (i % 2 == 0) { total += i. } ELSE { total -= i. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).
